This Ayurvedic medicine is prepared from Dashmoola or well-known ten roots of Ayurveda and various other medicinal herbs. It is very nutritious and improves immunity.

sections.dosage:
Consume 5-10 grams 1-2 times per day after or before having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is administered along with honey or warm water. 

 Dosage for children below 5 years of age: 1-2 grams, 1-2 times along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Dosage for children between 5-12 years of age: 5 grams 1-2 times a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
Dashmoola Rasayana is useful in treating Chronic respiratory conditions like bronchitis asthma. 
 It is efficient medicine in case of chronic fever, flatulence, bloating and hiccups. 
 One of the potent anti-inflammatory, bronchodilator and antitussive agent.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
No such side effects with this medicine is known. 
 But it’s over dose may cause stomach upset. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Dashmoola Rasayana 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam 
 Introduction 
 Dashmoola Rasayana is poly-herbal medicine effective for many acute and chronic respiratory diseases, available in the form of herbal jam. This Ayurvedic medicine is prepared from Dashmoola or well-known ten roots of Ayurveda and various other medicinal herbs. It is very nutritious and improves immunity. 
 Ingredients 
 Dasamoola:- 
 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Agnimantha – Premna mucronata 
 Shyonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Gambhari – Gmelina arborea 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Prinshnaparni – Urarica picta 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 
 
 Vrisha – Adhatoda vasica 
 Shunti – Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Jiraka – Cumin seed –  Cuminum cyminum 
 Dhanyaka – Coriander – Coraindrum sativum 
 Daru – Cedrus deodara 
 Bhadra – Aerua lanata 
 Sugar 
 
 Fine Powders of:- 
 
 Trikatu – Pepper, long pepper and ginger 
 Jati – Nutmeg – Myristica fragrans fruit and flower 
 Twak – Cinnamon – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Kumkuma – Saffron – Crocus sativus 
 Jiraka – Cuminum cyminum 
 Krishnajiraka – Nigella sativa 
 Pushkaramoola – Inula racemosa 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Ela – Cardamom – Elettaria cardamomum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Dashmoola Rasayana is prepared by addition of sugar into mixture of herbs and a jam like formulation is prepared. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 5-10 grams 1-2 times per day after or before having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is administered along with honey or warm water. 
 
 Dosage for children below 5 years of age: 1-2 grams, 1-2 times along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Dosage for children between 5-12 years of age: 5 grams 1-2 times a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Dashmoola Rasayana is useful in treating Chronic respiratory conditions like bronchitis asthma. 
 It is efficient medicine in case of chronic fever, flatulence, bloating and hiccups. 
 One of the potent anti-inflammatory, bronchodilator and antitussive agent. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 No such side effects with this medicine is known. 
 But it’s over dose may cause stomach upset. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
